title: Evidence:four adults each charged with 16 second-degree felony child-endangering counts

data.claim: The Ohio Attorney General reported that Gary Siders Jr., Elizabeth Siders, Gary Siders Sr., and Christina Siders were arraigned July 1, 2026, and each charged with 16 counts of endangering children, a second-degree felony.
data.notes: Victim identities and exact residential address intentionally omitted.
